ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'The Day of Judgement' in Shia Islamic theology?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Yawm al-Fasl' (The Day of Separation) is understood as the definitive moment when the veil of worldly ambiguity is lifted, revealing the ultimate truth of one's faith and actions. This concept is deeply tied to the dualistic worldview of the Hereafter, where the righteous and the wicked are permanently segregated, reflecting the justice of Imam Ali (AS) who emphasized clarity in divine judgment. It serves as a reminder for believers to prepare for this decisive separation through righteous deeds and adherence to the Ahl al-Bayt.
